title: Algophony Prompt Categories
description: 10 prompt categories for the Algophony Atlas v0.1, each targeting a specific benchmark question.

categories.label: Forest
categories.benchmark_question: Does the model generate ecological specificity or generic nature?

categories.label: City
categories.benchmark_question: Does it understand urban layers beyond traffic?

categories.label: Coast
categories.benchmark_question: Can it balance water, wind, distance, birds, and human presence?

categories.label: Interior
categories.benchmark_question: Can it generate small-scale domestic acoustics?

categories.label: Machine
categories.benchmark_question: Does it distinguish machine source, rhythm, space, and material?

categories.label: Ritual
categories.benchmark_question: Does it avoid generic exoticism or cinematic cliché?

categories.label: Archive
categories.benchmark_question: Can it simulate media decay and historical distance?

categories.label: Club Exterior
categories.benchmark_question: Can it generate muffled social/music environments without becoming full music?

categories.label: Ruin
categories.benchmark_question: Does it imply abandonment, weathering, absence, and material decay?

categories.label: Impossible Ecology
categories.benchmark_question: Can it remain coherent while inventing a non-real environment?
